WHEREAS, Cheyenne Frontier Days ("CFD")relies heavily on sponsorships to assist in
producing theyearly Cheyenne Frontier Days rodeo events andhas established various levels of
sponsor relationships based on value including Platinum Arrowhead, Titanium, Bronze
Arrowhead, Gold Boot, Bronze, Chute 9 sponsor, and Silver Boot sponsor;
WHEREAS, Bison Beverage is a local malt beverage industry representative for Molson
Coors Beverage Company brands Miller and Coors and is interested in establishing a two-year
sponsor relationship with CFD;
WHEREAS, the activities of alcohol industry representatives are strictly regulated under
Title12of Wyoming Statute;
WHEREAS, Wyoming Statute12-5-402(a)provides that"industry representatives shall
not furnish, give or lend money or other things of value, directly or indirectly, to any person
engaged in selling products of the industry atretail under privileges of a license orpermit to sell
any beverage orliquorin Wyoming."The statute further staters that this"prohibition shall extend
to the giving to any person for the use, benefit or relief of the person engaged in selling the
industry'sproducts and to prohibit guaranty by theindustry of a loan or other financial obligation
of persons engaged atretail inselling these products.";
WHEREAS, Wyoming Statute 12-5-402(a) outlines an exception to the prohibition
imposed upon industry representatives by further providing that"with prior approval of the
applicable licensing authority, malt beverage industry representatives may furnish, give or lend
money or other things of value to alicensee to support annual community events open to the public
if the licensee:(i) Is a nonprofit corporation organized under the laws of this state;(i) Is qualified
as a tax exempt organization under the Internal Revenue Code; and (ii) Has been in continuous
operation fora period of not less than two (2) years.";
WHEREAS, Cheyenne Frontier Days holds a retail liquor license, which license was
granted by the City of Cheyenne as the local licensing authority in accordance with Wyoming
Statute12-4-201;
WHEREAS, in accordance with state law, CFD and Bison Beverage are seeking prior
approval from the City of Cheyenne to partner for a sponsor relationship which will allow Bison
Beverage to furnish, give or lend money or other things ofvalue to CFD to support the annual
community event of Cheyenne Frontier Days rodeo, occurring on July19 through July28,2024,
and July18through July27,2025; and
